---
title: "Open-Source Software"
---

**These are my open-source packages, indexed under the [PinasR](https://pinasr.r-universe.dev/builds) repository that I also maintain.** My software were not really designed to teach you something new, but to give it a lens to see your reality. Thus if you cannot easily relate to the outputs while using my tools, it's a failure of my software, not your intelligence. I'd be so glad if we could update these tools together by submitting an issue to their respective repositories.
